question_text: Under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution, the State is mandated to protect the rights of workers and promote agrarian reform. Which of the following scenarios best exemplifies this mandate?

options.text: The government provides tax incentives to large agricultural corporations to boost exports.
The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) conducts inspections to ensure compliance with minimum wage laws.
The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) lowers tariffs on imported rice to lower food prices.
The government builds more roads in rural areas to improve access to markets.
